rv.q: The production is tonally imbalanced and far more corny than it is cutting or inspiring.
It’s refreshing to see such creativity on the stage, lovingly and vividly produced, seeking to break boundaries in more ways than one.
Still, this is an enjoyable and relevant play, despite its flippant jokiness, and with its imperfections.
Still, best of intentions aside, this one just wasn’t for me.

cn.t: Critics find this feminist time-hopping comedy well-performed and designed, but the play itself receives mixed reactions for its uneven execution of reimagining history through women's eyes.
